== 说明 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom 信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>{{Book
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如“Example.jpg”]
 | author        = 
 | illustrator   = 
 | datePublished = 
 | publisher     = 
 | previous      = 
 | next          = 
}}</pre>

== 示例输出 ==
{{Book
 | title         = The Adventures of Flower
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | author        = Alice
 | illustrator   = Bob
 | datePublished = April 1928
 | publisher     = Arthur's
 | previous      = Book One
 | next          = Book Three
}}
<pre>{{Book
 | title         = The Adventures of Flower
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | author        = Alice
 | illustrator   = Bob
 | datePublished = April 1928
 | publisher     = Arthur's

}}
